items.description: The current US BES995 is the newer Oracle Dual Boiler with a 5.7-inch touch screen, 45-setting integrated Baratza burr system, automated grinding, dosing and tamping, and separate brew and steam boilers.
items.bestFor: A US household making several milk drinks that wants simultaneous steam and brewing
